This is hymn number 307 titled "In Our Lovely Deseret" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in B-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Ebenezer Beesley and the lyrics were written by Eliza R. Snow.
